## 🔴 High Relevance (Score 7–10)

**[DCAF15-ANKIB1 E3 super-complex licenses NLRP3 inflammasome activation via KAT5 serine ubiquitination.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43069261/)** *(from Ubiquitin biology / E3 ligase biochemistry (sepsis inflammation))*  
*Yin Hang; Li Yuqing; Meng Anqi; Cao Xuefeng; Lang Shiqi* — EMBO reports 2026  
Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `NLRP3, treatment-target, NF-kB-NLRP3-priming, other`  
> The paper identifies the DCAF15-ANKIB1 E3 complex as a positive regulator of NLRP3 inflammasome activation through KAT5 Ser123 ubiquitination and NLRP3 acetylation, a new mechanism and potential drug target for NLRP3 hyperactivation. ANKIB1 is on the tracked player list (gain control of interferonopathy amplitude), but the work is a sepsis/LPS macrophage study with no SAMHD1, mtDNA, dNTP, or interferon link, so it supports the downstream NLRP3 node only indirectly.  
DOI: 10.1038/s44319-026-00987-y

**[PEDV S protein induces CMPK2 to activate cGAS-STING and NLRP3 antiviral signaling through MLS-dependent mitochondrial localization.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43076392/)** *(from Veterinary virology (swine coronavirus))*  
*Geng Xinmei; Zhu Mingjun; Wang Jianing; Yuan Boshui; Qian Bingxu* — Journal of virology 2026  
Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `cGAS-STING, NLRP3, POLG-mtDNA, mito-dNTP-transport, nucleotide-rewiring, JAK-STAT, other`  
> The paper shows that CMPK2, the regulated mitochondrial dNTP salvage kinase, is induced by IFN-I/IRF1 and must localize to mitochondria (via its MLS) to generate and release ox-mtDNA, which activates cGAS-STING and NLRP3. This is the CMPK2-dependent arm of the mitochondrial dNTP supply gate that the UTSW/Zhong 2026 PNC1/2 bypass model contrasts with. It supports the ox-mtDNA to cGAS-STING/NLRP3 axis in the SAMHD1 A565T mechanism and suggests an IFN-I to CMPK2 to ox-mtDNA feed-forward loop. It is porcine viral (PEDV) work with no SAMHD1 data, so the relevance is mechanistic rather than direct.  
DOI: 10.1128/jvi.01145-26

**[Dual positive-feedback loops and a bidirectional lactate rheostat converging on the cGAS-STING pathway in rheumatoid arthritis.](https://europepmc.org/article/MED/43075250)** *(from Rheumatology)*  
*Wang Meng; Liu Yang; Xu Ke* —  2026  
Score: **7/10** | Pathways: `cGAS-STING, ISG15-mitophagy, treatment-target, clinical-phenotype, NF-kB-IKK, mito-ROS-NF-kB, other`  
> This RA review proposes self-reinforcing loops converging on cGAS-STING, including TNF-α-driven PINK1-mitophagy repression causing cytosolic mtDNA leakage and lactate-driven mtDNA release. These mirror the family's Loop A (mtDNA-cGAS-STING) and the mitophagy block, and the druggability analysis (cGAS-STING antagonists, PINK1 agonists) is relevant to treatment. Rheumatoid arthritis is a tracked family phenotype. It has no SAMHD1 or dNTP data, and it is a speculative synthesis rather than primary evidence, so it does not score higher.  
DOI: 10.3389/fimmu.2026.2005762
